title: Dream Places I've Been To
content: I was talking to my partner yesterday about dreams and I was explaining the reoccurring places I go, how real they feel and that they were all interconnected, all a part of the same world. Today I couldn't stop thinking about it and tada! I was lead here. Mind freaking blown lol. I wanted to note the places I've visited and see where that goes. I guess I'll start with places inside the Mall and go from there. LMK if you've been to these and how they compare! *Casino/Arcade/Bowling Alley* I've been to the Casino with the Arcade and Bowling Alley many times. The arcade is never really very fun, I've only tried to play there a couple times, usually I just pass by or through it. I've only bowled one time, most of the time I don't even see it, I just know it exists. I've gambled a few times but never win, or if I do it doesn't matter for some reason. Moving off to one side of the casino where the music gets louder and it's kind of darker (I don't go far so I don't know what's past there or where it goes) I've been there a few times. There's people there I know (not irl). The restaurants in the casino are okaaaay, except they're almost always out of something I want. *The Hotel* I don't like the hotel, like at all. To be fair I'm always on a low level so maybe it's different in other areas. It's slumy and dank feeling and half the time something bad is happening. The rooms are weird. Most of them don't have doors and there's multiple rooms all in one separated by half walls. I've been on the outside of it a few times too. *Gymnasium? Room* There's this one area I end up getting stuck in pretty often. It's an unrealistically large area that I can only think to call a gymnasium. All around the top there are tunnels (but square shaped, not circular). They're clear and you can see all the way down. There are different levels/floors and at the bottom is a basketball court with a stage to one side and bleachers on the edges. Only it's unbelievably huge. I've seen different things events happen on stage, sometimes I'm involved and other times I'm not. *Bathroom* Down a long hallway from the gymnasium is a bathroom/locker room. There are very few personal spaces in here. There's the half walls for some of the toilets, other than that it's pretty open, no shower curtains, doors or coverage. It's all females in there. No privacy. And it's so dirty, dank and old feeling. I really don't like it there either, I'm usually only here during anxiety dreams. There was one time I remember it being different, there was some kind of bad chaos happening and everyone in there was scared for their lives. When I'm up top in the tunnels I usually feel like I'm running from something. Last time it felt really close and I just wanted to crawl out of my skin. I've never been to the in between levels here, that I know of, I just see them from far away. There's always a ton of people everywhere doing their own things. *Water Park Ride* Somewhere from up in these tunnels I have found a path that goes higher and leads to a part of the water park. On the way up it's like climbing up the first part of a McDonald's play place. At the top I come to a water ride that seems like a water slide but the thing you sit in is more like a bumper car. Always a lot of excitement and movement happening around here. *Transportation Area* Coming down from the water slide I reach a transportation area. It looks the way a train station would but it's in the sky. There are clouds all around like we're floating in the sky and I can't see land anywhere. Even though it looks like a train station and I've taken a train from here. I've also taken an airplane a couple times. And one time, probably one of the most crazy feeling dreams I've ever had, I took a rocket ship into space. I can't explain it very well. I remember the anticipation and fear before takeoff, I could feel my stomach doing flips as we started going up. It felt so real. There were a couple people with me but I can't remember them, what we talked about or anything. As we made it into space, I could see Earth getting smaller and then we were just everywhere...zooming through solar systems or galaxies. It felt fascinating, exhilarating, and completely wild. We did things and stopped places, talked to people, but that's all too foggy. *Right Outside the Mall* I assume there are countless entrances but if I'm right outside, it's always the same set of doors. It's always dark or almost dark out. There's a set of concrete circular shaped set of stairs leading up to a set of oversized double doors. And there are always two... bodyguards I guess. They're not exactly human but idk why, I just kind of know they aren't. It seems like if I'm out here, there's usually something crazy bad happening. *Lakeview Beach with forest/woods behind it* I've been here a few times. Seems crowded usually. Once I got to sit and enjoy the view with my fiance. A couple times I had to flee into the woodsy area behind it. *House of Ashes* There's a mansion that I go to sometimes that looks like how you would imagine a haunted house on a Halloween logo of some kind, sort of skinny and tall. Except that it's completely made of Ashes (or charcoal or something) yet still held together fine. There's a room off to the side in there that leads to the attic, the pull string kind. For me, the ceiling from up there has slowly been disintegrating and falling apart. The last time I was there, a couple weeks ago, there was an old hag lady pointing up at the attic, which is now bulging out like it's about to explode. I started telling my fiance about this one the other day and part way through burst into tears and started having an anxiety attack. A couple places/things of note that I know were in the same world/realm but haven't been but one or two times. *Somewhere in the middle of nowhere, and by that I mean pure darkness all around, there was a huge tree. It was bare of leaves on its many twisting branches. And it had baby doll parts tied and hanging all over it, like a decorated Christmas tree. *The neighborhood that looks like on Edward Scissorhands, pink, yellow, blue, with perfect lawns and whatnot. *And then there's a woman I met a few times. I don't know how to explain it because I couldn't quite see her features, at least that I can recall, but she was the most beautiful being I've ever encountered. The was an ethereal feeling to her that was enchanting. I've not seen her in a few years but it has stuck with me.
